name: Speech Transcription
description: Speech becomes text, on this computer only: a microphone button in the main toolbar starts and stops a recording (the arrow beside it chooses the microphone), and what is said is written into a new transcription file, listed in the inspector's tab "Transcriptions", where it can be edited and copied. You can also record only, using little power, and let the text be written later with Transcribe. Nothing is sent anywhere; a speech model is downloaded once under File > Options > Speech and then used without any connection.
author: Quillbinder
whatsNew: Speech recognition now runs in Quillbinder's AI Engine: install it once under File > Options > Speech (it is shared with the other AI functions), and the graphics cards of the computer (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) can be chosen for the speed
The processor cores and the time after which an unused model is freed are the program's one setting for all AI functions (File > Options > General > AI Models)
New: the button Insert at Cursor in the Transcriptions tab, and the option Write into the text as I speak
Needs Quillbinder 0.99.0 or later (older programs keep version 1.9)
details: Recognition by whisper.cpp inside the AI Engine add-on; the model (Small, Medium, Large v3 or Large v3 Turbo) is chosen, downloaded and checked once, then used without any connection.
A main language for the text and a fallback language that is also spoken: with English as the main language, what is said in the other language is written in English.
Graphics cards are used through Vulkan when the AI Engine finds one.
Brings Qt Multimedia 6.12.1 for the microphone and Qt's TLS plugin for the download.
Built for the program's runtime u2404-qt6.12-r2 (Qt 6.12.1), Quillbinder 0.99.0 and later.
